admission.justification: Separately owned serving composition, observation scheduling and safety operations must not mistake missing page interest or launch permission for permission to hide required observations; operation-level tests guard the distinct boundary.

applicability: Transient per-contract due state in serving-bound landing observation.
conditions: Only current eligible exact identities are retained at interested discovery.
Semantic answer fields and row ordering determine the unchanged epoch; the fact at is semantic.
Due periods are checked on ordinary sweeps and are not total publication-latency bounds.
exclusions: The schedule is not durable landing truth.
Observation timestamps and computed age alone do not change a semantic answer.
Explicit unbound refresh calls do not use the policy.
statement: Serving landing probes use30seconds while a semantic answer is unchanged for under120seconds, then120/600/3600seconds by unchanged age; semantic answer or contract changes reset freshness and the schedule retains only current contract identities, while explicit unbound refresh callers keep their existing API.
